scripts.start: npm run build:web && npm run start -w @pokelearning/server
scripts.test: npm test -w @pokelearning/server && npm test -w @pokelearning/ocr-macos && npm run test:lua
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p adapters/ocr-macos
scripts.panel:build: mkdir -p apps/panel-macos/bin && swiftc -O -parse-as-library -o apps/panel-macos/bin/pokelearning-panel apps/panel-macos/PanelCore.swift apps/panel-macos/PanelMain.swift
scripts.app:build: mkdir -p apps/desktop-macos/bin && swiftc -O -parse-as-library -o apps/desktop-macos/bin/Pokelearning apps/panel-macos/PanelCore.swift apps/desktop-macos/ScriptingWindow.swift apps/desktop-macos/Server.swift apps/desktop-macos/HotKeys.swift apps/desktop-macos/App.swift
